brief:
Israeli occupation forces shot three Palestinians on Sunday evening during an incursion into the village of Mugheir, located northeast of Ramallah in the West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. The shooting occurred as troops entered the community in what the agency described as a military operation in the area.

The three wounded Palestinians were struck by live fire during the raid. The circumstances that prompted the Israeli military operation and the current condition of those injured remained unclear. No statement was immediately issued by Israeli forces regarding the incursion or its objectives.
